nodes.name: ranking.rs
nodes.summary: Ranks and retrieves active learnings by salience: an AgeBucket freshness classifier, a composite salience_score algorithm, ranked listing, and cosine-similarity vector search over stored embeddings.

nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Owns the learnings table DDL (init_learnings_table) and the content-hash function used for reinforcement dedup.

nodes.name: stats.rs
nodes.summary: Read-side reporting queries for the UI/CLI: filtered listing of learnings, per-scope status counts, and the most recent consolidation run summary.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core domain model for the learnings store: the Learning struct plus LearningCategory, EvolutionType, LearningStatus, and LearningSource enums, each with as_str/parse string round-trips for SQLite storage.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root of the agent memory subsystem; documents the three-tier architecture (embeddings, learnings/consolidation as L3, workspace_memory as L2, reflection write paths) and re-exports commands, consolidation, embeddings, learnings, reflection, and workspace_memory as public submodules, plus the shared MemoryAgentParams struct for forked memory agents.

nodes.name: auto_dream.rs
nodes.summary: Offline "auto-dream" background agent that periodically consolidates redundant or stale workspace-memory markdown files: gates on elapsed time/session count (should_attempt), then runs an LLM-driven consolidation pass (run_consolidation) building its own prompt from recent session activity.

nodes.name: gating.rs
nodes.summary: Decides per-turn whether the forked memory-extraction agent should run: message-count thresholds, skipping when the main agent already wrote a memory file this turn, and pending-message stashing between checks.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel for the per-turn memory-extraction subsystem; defines NoopEventHandler (a do-nothing EventHandler implementation used by the forked extraction agent) and re-exports the gating/runner/state submodules.

nodes.name: runner.rs
nodes.summary: Drives the forked LLM memory-extraction agent that reads recent conversation turns and existing workspace memory to decide whether to write or update a workspace-memory markdown file.

nodes.name: age_days_since_last_touch
nodes.summary: Computes days elapsed since a learning was last recalled, used as the recency component of salience scoring.

nodes.name: age_days_f64
nodes.summary: Computes a fractional-day age value for a learning, used for finer-grained freshness weighting.

nodes.name: salience_score
nodes.summary: Combines recency, reinforcement count, and importance into a single composite score used to rank active learnings.

nodes.name: load_active_learnings_ranked
nodes.summary: Loads active learnings for a scope and sorts them by salience score, highest first.

nodes.name: search_similar
nodes.summary: Runs a cosine-similarity vector search over active learnings' embeddings, returning the top-k matches above a minimum similarity threshold.

nodes.name: AgeBucket
nodes.summary: Freshness classification (Recent/Medium/Old) derived from a learning's age in days, used as an input to salience scoring.

nodes.name: compute_content_hash
nodes.summary: Normalizes and hashes a learning's content+category with SHA-256 to produce the dedup key used by content_hash_dedup.

nodes.name: init_learnings_table
nodes.summary: Creates the learnings table and its indexes/columns if they do not already exist.

nodes.name: list_learnings
nodes.summary: Runs a filtered, paginated query over learnings for a scope, used by the UI/CLI browser.

nodes.name: count_status_per_scope
nodes.summary: Aggregates learning counts per lifecycle status (pending/active/merged/deprecated/abandoned) for a scope.

nodes.name: latest_consolidation_run
nodes.summary: Fetches the most recent consolidation_runs row for a scope for status display.

nodes.name: LearningListFilter
nodes.summary: Filter criteria (status, source, category, search text, limit) accepted by the list_learnings query.

nodes.name: LearningsStatusCounts
nodes.summary: Aggregate counts of learnings per lifecycle status for a scope, returned by count_status_per_scope.

nodes.name: Learning
nodes.summary: Core domain struct for a stored learning: content, takeaway, category, importance/confidence, embedding, lifecycle status, evolution lineage, and timestamps.

nodes.name: LearningCategory
nodes.summary: Enum of learning categories: Pattern, Correction, Preference, or Strategy, with as_str/parse round-trips.

nodes.name: EvolutionType
nodes.summary: Enum tracking how a learning relates to its parent in the evolution DAG: Original, Refined, or Deprecated.

nodes.name: LearningStatus
nodes.summary: Lifecycle status enum for a learning: Pending, Active, Merged, Deprecated, or Abandoned.

nodes.name: LearningSource
nodes.summary: Enum identifying how a learning was produced: Reflection, PatternExtraction, or ActiveObservation.

nodes.name: MemoryAgentParams
nodes.summary: Shared parameter bundle (messages, provider, model, workspace, parent tools, session ID, definitions store) passed to forked memory agents like extract_memories and auto_dream, kept together to stay within clippy's argument-count limit.

nodes.name: should_attempt
nodes.summary: Decides whether the auto-dream consolidation pass should run now based on elapsed time since the last scan and hours since last file-lock-recorded consolidation.

nodes.name: run_consolidation
nodes.summary: Acquires the file lock, builds an LLM prompt from recent session activity, runs the forked consolidation agent over workspace memory files, and rolls back the lock on failure.

nodes.name: count_sessions_since
nodes.summary: Counts workspace sessions started after a given timestamp, used to gate auto-dream on session activity volume.

nodes.name: build_consolidation_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt given to the auto-dream forked agent, summarizing recent session count and the current memory directory state.

nodes.name: AutoDreamState
nodes.summary: Tracks the last time auto-dream scanned for consolidation opportunities, used to throttle background scans.

nodes.name: should_extract
nodes.summary: Top-level gate deciding whether the per-turn memory-extraction agent should run for the latest exchange, combining new-message count and prior-write checks.

nodes.name: skip_if_main_agent_wrote_memory
nodes.summary: Skips triggering the forked extraction agent when the main agent already wrote a workspace-memory file itself during this turn.

nodes.name: stash_pending
nodes.summary: Stashes messages that arrived while extraction was gated off, so they are considered on the next eligible turn.

nodes.name: take_pending
nodes.summary: Drains and returns any previously stashed pending messages for the extraction agent to process.

nodes.name: record_turn
nodes.summary: Increments the turns-since-last-extraction counter in the extraction state.

nodes.name: count_new_messages
nodes.summary: Counts messages added to the conversation since a given index, used for extraction-trigger thresholds.

nodes.name: has_memory_writes_since
nodes.summary: Scans tool calls since a given message index for writes into the workspace-memory path, used to detect the main agent already saved a memory.

nodes.name: extract_written_path
nodes.summary: Extracts the file path argument from a tool call, used to check whether it targeted the workspace-memory directory.

nodes.name: NoopEventHandler
nodes.summary: No-op implementation of the EventHandler trait (on_message_delta/on_tool_call/on_tool_result) used to run the forked extraction agent without streaming events to the UI.

nodes.name: run_extraction
nodes.summary: Drives the forked memory-extraction agent end to end: builds the prompt from recent messages and the current memory manifest, runs the agent, and persists any resulting memory writes.

nodes.name: build_extraction_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt for the extraction agent, embedding the count of new messages and the current memory-file manifest.
